concerns.text: Task T012b (fetch ALL commits) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T012a (fetch repo list). The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section correctly notes this dependency, but the [P] tag on T012b is misleading as it cannot run in parallel with T012a. Remove [P] from T012b.
Task T019b (Mock Annotation Generator) is marked [P] but depends on T019a (generate sample list). T019b cannot run in parallel with T019a as it requires the output of T019a. Remove [P] from T019b.
Task T019c (ingest annotations) is marked [P] but depends on T019b (generate mock annotations). T019c cannot run in parallel with T019b. Remove [P] from T019c.

Task T023 (descriptive stats) depends on T014 (excluded repos list) and T018 (processed data). While T014 and T018 are in US1, T023 is in US2. The task order implies US2 can start after Foundational, but T023 specifically requires US1 outputs. The 'Dependencies' section clarifies this, but the task list should explicitly show T023 depends on T014/T018 completion, not just 'Foundational'.

Task T026 (Stratified MWU) depends on T024 (outlier calculation) for the 'full dataset' vs 'cleaned dataset' distinction, and T023 for descriptive stats. The [P] tag on T026 is incorrect as it cannot run in parallel with T023/T024. Remove [P] from T026.
Task T034b (load spot-check results) depends on T020 (save spot-check results). T034b is marked [P] but cannot run in parallel with T020. Remove [P] from T034b.
Task T035 (conditional limitation logic) depends on T034b (calculate false-negative rate). T035 is marked [P] but cannot run in parallel with T034b. Remove [P] from T035.

Task T036b (render final report) depends on T034 (assemble report), T035 (limitation logic), T029 (statistical results), and T033 (boxplot). T036b is marked [P] but cannot run in parallel with any of these. Remove [P] from T036b.
